<documents>
<document id="support-deceased">
IfˆanˆaccountˆholderˆhasˆdiedˆWe'reˆsorryˆforˆyourˆloss.ˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆletˆusˆknowˆthatˆaˆTallowbrookˆmemberˆhasˆdied.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆBereavement,ˆorˆmessageˆsupport.ˆSupportˆpassesˆeveryˆbereavementˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆitˆfromˆstartˆtoˆfinish.ˆ##ˆWhatˆAccountˆServicesˆwillˆaskˆforˆ-ˆTheˆdeathˆcertificateˆ-ˆProofˆthatˆyou'reˆtheˆexecutorˆorˆadministratorˆofˆtheˆestate,ˆorˆtheˆnextˆofˆkinˆ-ˆYourˆphotoˆIDˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆOnceˆwe'reˆnotified,ˆweˆfreezeˆtheˆaccountˆandˆcardsˆtoˆprotectˆthem.ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆstop.ˆDirectˆdepositsˆreceivedˆafterˆtheˆdateˆofˆdeathˆmayˆbeˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆAfterˆAccountˆServicesˆconfirmsˆwho'sˆauthorized,ˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆpaidˆtoˆtheˆestate.ˆ##ˆTimingˆAccountˆServicesˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆPleaseˆdon'tˆtryˆtoˆsignˆinˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆorˆuseˆitsˆcards.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="products-under-18">
Accountsˆforˆunder-18sˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpeopleˆagedˆ18ˆandˆover.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆteenˆaccounts,ˆcustodialˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆchildren.ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆyoungˆpersonˆIfˆyourˆchildˆhasˆanˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆyouˆcanˆsendˆmoneyˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ##ˆAddingˆaˆchildˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcan'tˆaddˆaˆchildˆasˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆgiveˆthemˆaˆcardˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheyˆturnˆ18ˆTheyˆcanˆapplyˆforˆtheirˆownˆaccountˆinˆtheˆappˆwithˆtheirˆownˆIDˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆparent'sˆaccountˆPleaseˆdon'tˆletˆsomeoneˆelseˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆapp.ˆTransactionsˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆtoˆaren'tˆcoveredˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆStudentsˆStudentsˆagedˆ18ˆandˆoverˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆlikeˆanyoneˆelse.ˆ##ˆGiftsˆforˆaˆchildˆWeˆcan'tˆholdˆmoneyˆonˆaˆchild'sˆbehalf.ˆIfˆyouˆwantˆtoˆsaveˆforˆaˆchild,ˆyouˆcanˆcreateˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆinˆyourˆownˆaccountˆandˆnameˆitˆafterˆthem.ˆTheˆmoneyˆstaysˆyours.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
